task_name: Collect Factory Materials, Upgrade Two Residential Zones, and Build Second Water Tower

when_to_do_it.trigger_condition: When factories finish producing Metal and Wood, two residential zones have ready hard hats, and a red water droplet alert appears as Water Demand (10) exceeds Capacity (9).
when_to_do_it.strategic_reasoning: Upgrading the two residential zones increases population to 1,418, which pushes water demand past the single Water Tower's capacity of 9. Building a second Basic Water Tower immediately raises capacity to 18 and prevents Sim unhappiness.
preconditions: Finished Metal and Wood on factories
6,000 Simoleons available for a second Basic Water Tower
when_to_do_it.placement_rule: Place the second Basic Water Tower next to Town Hall on the lower road to keep the main residential street clear for homes and parks.

steps.who: floating Metal and Wood on the northern Small Factories
steps.briefing: collect all finished materials and re-queue Metal and Wood.

steps.who: yellow hard hats on two ready Residential Zones
steps.briefing: drag Wood (2/2) & Metal (17/2) onto the first zone and Wood (2/2) onto the second zone to upgrade them.
open the Water service catalog when the red water shortage alert appears.
drag the Water Tower onto the lower road directly beside Town Hall and click the green checkmark.
